title: Perfect massage for couples.
text: My partner and I went as a gift for a 30-minute massage with Jazmin and Lea and it was spectacular. Very relaxing and with the perfect pressure. Both were very kind, we will return without a doubt!

title: Unique couple experience
text: We have been to Thai Massage Barcelona several times and always leave happy. This time we did the massage as a couple with bathroom, and it was an amazing experience. The Mood is very relaxing, the staff very professional and attentive, and the massages always of great quality. It’s our favorite plan to celebrate birthdays, because we know we come out fresh and happy. Definitely a place to repeat again and again.
author: Jordina O

title: Wonderful.

title: Excellent massage and floral bath
text:
We were given massage with floral bath as a couple before confinement and have decided to take advantage of it now.
Upon arriving at the massage room, we saw the Jacuzzi prepared with candles and roses floating. Lovely.
Massage, being 30 min we choose back and shoulders. Next time best book 60 min full body massage!!
After the 30 min massage, we had our candles and rose petals removed from the Jacuzzi and enjoyed a great swim.
A very pleasant and relaxing experience highly recommended
author: 219tanita
